Commentary.Commentary: The England bowlers weren't poor. They tried hard but without much success. A few chances went down too. But you cannot take the credit away from India. They dealt with the conditions superbly to blunt the English pacers. Adil Rashid was a big disappointment for the home team. Hardik Pandya towards the end salted the wounds even more with an attacking half century. Stay tuned for England's reply...

A powerful batting show by India yet again. After gaining a handsome lead, their batsmen came out with positive intent and batted with a lot of control. Their openers once again laid a strong platform and then the pair of Cheteshwar Pujara and Virat Kohli swelled the lead with a century partnership. The former missed his ton but the Indian skipper once again displayed his class by notching up his second hundred of the series. One can feel that the tourists delayed in declaring their innings but they still have 189 overs to take England's 9 wickets (Bairstow with a fractured finger is doubtful to bat).

Here comes the declaration. England's misery is over, finally. India have set a gigantic target of 521 runs in front of the home team to win this Test and seal the series. A nearly impossible task and England will consider themselves lucky if they come out unscathed.
Tossed up fuller on the stumps. Pandya comes forward and turns it away towards the mid-wicket region for a single. Is Kohli calling his boys back?
Ashwin elegantly drives this floated delivery to the mid on region. They cross over.
Pandya has pulled this short ball on middle. The fielder at deep mid-wicket keeps it for just a single.

OUT! Tossed up on middle. Shami gives this a full swing of the bat, and connects. It looks like it will sail over the ropes but it has been taken near the boundary line at deep mid-wicket by Cook. No declaration still as Ashwin is seen coming out to bat.
Way outside off by Rashid, Pandya reaches out and cuts it to the fielder at cover point for a single

FOUR! Rashid continues and Pandya also continues, smashing him. He is in T20 mode now. Rashid drags this one a bit shorter. Pandya stays back and hits it hard straight down the ground. No chance for the fielder at long on to cut it off. Gets to his fifty with a good strong shot.
Excellent running! A yorker on off, Shami jams it out towards covers and the batsmen run two.
On the stumps, Pandya guides it through point and gets to the other end.

A big appeal but not given! An inswinger on middle, Shami tries to flick but misses. The ball hits him on the pads. The players appeal as the batsmen run through for another leg bye. The umpire shakes his head as it is going down leg.
Pandya uses his feet but Broad follows him with a full ball on the pads. He swings but misses to get hit on the pads. The ball rolls towards the off side and the batsmen run a leg bye.
Good length, angling into the batsman, cramping him for room. Pandya defends it.
Down the leg side, Pandya misses the flick and it goes into the mitts of the keeper.
Darted in a bit quicker targeting the stumps, Shami works it to the mid-wicket region.
Tossed up but a bit shorter. Shami shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Pandya swings hard again. But this time he is not to the pitch of the ball. The ball grips and turns away taking the outside edge. But the ball flies down towards the third man region. The fielder at short third man chases it down and saves a run for his team.

SIX! That's huge from Pandya. Rashid tosses this up, enticing Pandya to go for the big shot. Pandya obliges and swings hard. Gets enough elevation and power for the ball to sail over the long on fence.
Short ball spinning outside off. Shami cuts it well for a single.
Mohammed Shami walks in next.

OUT! And India lose their sixth wicket. Rashid delivers it short on the off stump line. Not enough room to play the square cut but Rahane still tries to manufacture a shot. Fails to put bat on ball and gets bowled. End of a strange knock by Ajinkya. Not sure what was the plan behind his approach to batting.
Length ball on middle, pitches and nips away. It beats Pandya's outside edge and the ball goes just over the top of the middle stump.
FOUR! Pandya on the move. Stokes lands it shorter and wide of off. Pandya unleashes the fierce cut, no chance for the fielder at deep cover to cut this out.
FOUR! VVS Laxman would have been proud of this shot. Length ball angling into Pandya who leans across and flicks this on the up. The ball races to the deep mid-wicket boundary.
Fuller on off stump, defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller attacking the stumps, Pandya drives this to mid on.
Back of a length ball outside the off stump, the ball stays a bit low and moves away and thereby beating the outside edge of Pandya's bat.
Stuart Broad comes into the attack.
Shorter outside off, batsman rocks onto the backfoot and punches the ball. One run added to the total.
Tossed up on off. Pandya tries to punch it but gets an inside edge onto his pads. No run.
Pandya's front foot defense it beaten again due to the spin away.
Leg spinner on off stump. Pandya tries to block but is beaten by the away spin.
Plays this slower and shorter delivery just outside off to the point region by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Shorter and wider of off, Pandya goes back and punches it hard in the cover region. Gets only one though.
Banged in short and outside off. Rahane lets it go.
Full on off, Rahane drives to mid off.
Stokes brings this in. But the swing is a bit too much which beats Rahane's pads. A diving Buttler pouches it.
Goes back to this shorter delivery on off, pushes it towards the point region.
This length ball pitches on off and moves away. Pandya is beaten on the outside edge.
FOUR! Pandya getting things moving now. Stokes keeps this full and outside off. It has a bit of away shape. But Pandya  plays the perfect lofted cover drive for a boundary.
Pushes this tossed up delivery on off stump to covers.
Very full this time on middle. Rahane prods forward and turns it away to mid-wicket.
Tossed up on off. Rahane drives but straight to the cover fielder.
A bit shorter and straighter from Rashid. Pandya goes back and flicks it into the square leg region for a single.
Tossed up outside off. Pandya leaves.
Tossed up just outside off. Pandya gets the broom out and sweeps it to deep square leg boundary. The fielder slides and saves two for his side.
Drinks.
The inswinger this time on off, Rahane prods forward and blocks it.
Unplayable! Stokes angles it into the batsman first and then gets it to leave him after pitching. Rahane plays inside the line and the ball almost kisses the outside edge of the bat.
A yorker on middle, Rahane jams it out to mid on.
A gentle full toss on off, Pandya mistimes his drive towards mid off for a run. He should have put that away. A boundary opportunity goes begging.
On a length around off, the batsman defends it.
A bumper on middle, Rahane rolls his wrists over it and pulls it along the ground to mid-wicket for a run.
FOUR! Intent from Pandya. Rashid gives this a bit more air and keeps it wide of off stump. Pandya gets under the ball and the lofted extra cover drive crosses the boundary in no time.
A bit shorter from Rashid outside off, Rahane goes back and punches to the cover-point region for a single.
Floated up on off stump. Rahane gets forward and defends.
Googly again, but much fuller. Rahane picks it this time, gets his front foot forwards and works it with the spin to mid-wicket.
Googly from Rashid. Rahane does not pick it and goes for the cut. The ball turns in, takes the inside edge of his bat, hits his pads and drops down.
Tossed up just outside off, Rahane drives softly to covers.
Tossed up on off stump, Pandya defends.
The outward movement on this length delivery on off stump almost squares up Rahane. He does well though to open the face of his bat and tap it to the point fielder for a single.
FOUR! Rahane does not let this one go. Stokes misses his line and length. Lands it a bit short and wide of off. Rahane cuts this one fiercely and the ball crosses the deep point boundary.
Length ball outside off, Rahane does not chase it.
Stokes get it straighter and on a length. Rahane defends with a straight bat.
The Indian vice-captain chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Beats the outside edge. Rashid pulls his length a bit and gets enough turn to beat Pandya bat.
Tossed up on off, Pandya taps it to the point region off the front foot.
Floated fuller just outside off. Rahane plays a beautiful cover drive but gets just a single for it.
Tossed up full on off. Rahane defends off the front foot.
Pandya goes for a heave on the leg side,  does not get it from the middle of the bat, the ball lobs over the mid-wicket fielder. They run just a single.
Tossed up on off, Rahane comes forward and pushes it into the cover point region, they switch over.
This inswinger strays on Rahane's legs. He works it away to fine leg for a single.
Length ball on off, Pandya waits back in his crease, opens the bat face and guides it to third man for a single.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Full and straight on the stumps. Pandya drives is back to the bowler.
Keeps it straight on the stumps. It moves away a touch on hitting the deck and takes the leading edge of his bat. But luckily the ball rolls down.
Stokes starts this from middle and leg and gets the ball to swing in prodigiously. The inward swing is a bit too much though. Buttler dives to his left to pouch it.
Wide! The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for the batsman. The umpire has signalled a wide.
Ben Stokes is back on.
Keeps it fuller and outside off. Rahane goes for the booming cover drive. The outward movement misses the edge of his bat. Seems like they are going for quick runs now.

Pandya slashes hard to this short and wide ball from Woakes. Gets a top edge and the ball flies towards the third man fielder who comes running in. But the ball falls way short of him. Pandya riding his luck.
Inswinger this time from Woakes. Angles this from outside off. Pandya waits for it to come near him and drives to mid on.
Beaten! Pandya this time goes to put bat on ball but is beaten by the away movement.
Fuller but way outside off. Pandya leaves.
Just short of a length on off stump, gets a bit of away movement on pitching. Pandya is almost squared up as he tries to defend with a straight bat.
Anderson keeps this just short of a length on off, it is moving away. Pandya gets across his stumps and glides this to third man for a single.
FOUR! Nice from Pandya. Anderson lands it a bit shorter outside off. Pandya goes back and across and cuts this between covers and point for a boundary.
He comes nicely forward and gets out a solid front foot defence.
This time Pandya chooses to leave this length ball outside off.
Out come one of the groundsmen with the big hammer. David Lloyd (on air) is providing the background music as he runs in to fix the issue near the bowler's landing area.
Beaten! Fullish on off stump, moving away. Pandya tries to put bat on ball but is not successful.
Anderson starts the over with a delivery straying on Pandya's legs. He flicks this elegantly past square leg for a boundary.
Fuller and just outside off, swinging away, Rahane pokes at it but misses.
Rahane this time gets right behind the line of the ball and blocks it out.
Length on off, prods forward and defends.
He lets this full ball go outside his off stump.
Beaten! Rahane this time is lured into a shot as Woakes lands this just outside the off stump. The ball moves away ever so slightly and luckily for the batsman does not get the outside edge.
Rahane shoulders arms to this fullish delivery outside off, moving away.
Bit straight on a length. Pandya comes forward and defends.
Length ball outside off. Pandya lets it go behind.

OUT! And Anderson's persistence on that line and length just outside off does the trick. The ball pitches on a length on off, moves away a bit. Pant tentatively hangs his bat out to defend it. Gets an outside edge and Alastair Cook at first slip takes it easily. Pant had the license to go bang bang, couldn't make it happen though. He'll feel a little disappointed. Anyway, Hardik Pandya will be the next batsman in.

Big appeal for a caught behind but the umpire is unmoved. Anderson feels there is a faint edge, discusses with his teammates and they decide not to go for the review. That was a very full delivery very wide of off stump, also shaping away from pant. Pant gives it a wild swing, T20 like, but misses completely. Anderson is not amused.
On a length again but much straighter this time. Pants defends it solidly.
Anderson comes around the wicket, keeps it on a length but the line is a bit too wide to entice Pant into a shot.
Works it with the angle towards fine leg for a run. Lead is now 450, how many more will they add?
Good length outside off, Pant guides it towards gully.

OUT! No inside edge and that is umpire's call. End of a magnificent innings from the Indian skipper. He walks off to a standing ovation from the crowd and he deserves every bit of it. He is dismissed shortly after getting to his ton but his knock has probably batted England out of the game. Coming to the delivery - Woakes bowls the inswinger on off, it tails back in late. Kohli tries to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. The players appeal and the umpire raises the finger. Kohli walks up to his partner and then after a chat, goes for the review. Replays roll in and they show the ball to be clipping the leg pole. England strike early after the Tea break, they would now hope to get a few more quickly.
Rishabh Pant is the new man in.
Kohli is a goner! He though has taken it upstairs, only an inside edge can save him here.
Good length on off, Kohli keeps it out.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat. The batsmen have run through for a single.
On a length around middle, Kohli tucks it through mid-wicket for a run.
Straighter this time, attacking the stumps. Rahane blocks it from the crease with a straight bat. End of a maiden from Anderson.
NThis length ball outside off is left alone by Rahane.
Very full on the off stump, Anderson trying his best to extract some extra swing. Rahane leans forward, accounts for the away movement and pushes it to mid off.
Third one in the same area and left again by the batsman.
Length ball this time on the same line, Rahane shoulders arms.
Starts the over with a full length delivery just outside the off stump, Anderson getting good out swing, Rahane lets it go.
Wide outside off, Kohli does not fiddle with it.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Good length on off, Kohli defends it on the ground.

FOUR! There it is, 100 for Kohli. His 23rd in this format. His second in the series. He had a forgetful tour of England in 2014 but he is making this one his. Truly a run machine. He does get there with a boundary though not convincing but again, he won't care. It is fuller and outside off, Kohli goes for the drive with gentle hands but he gets an outside edge through short third man and into the fence. He has his hands aloft, takes his helmet off and soaks in the applause by the crowd. Now that he has got to that milestone, he will be looking to up the ante. India lead by 447.
Wide outside off stump, the batsman leaves it alone.
Wide outside off, left alone.
Similar length but not a lot of movement this time. Kohli guides it towards backward point and takes a run.

EDGED AND SHORT NOW! When it is your day, everything will go as you wish. Another excellent delivery by Anderson. On the off stump and swinging away. Kohli lunges and tries to keep it out but the ball takes the outside edge and lands in front of Cook at first slip.

EDGED and that has gone through Jennings. Anderson is very, very frustrated and rightly so. The luck just is not going his way. Kohli won't care though as he now moves onto the score he was dismissed for in the first innings. James bowls it full and on off, it swings away late. Kohli tries to drive but gets a thick outside edge towards gully. Jennings there is a touch too close and hence fails to react. The ball goes between his legs and down to the third man fence. Brings up the 50-run stand between the two.
Goes full again and the line is on off, Kohli defends it solidly.
Swing this time but the line is way too outside off, left alone.
Starts off with a full ball on off, no swing. Kohli plants his front foot ahead and drives it to mid off.
James Anderson to bowl from the other end.
Drags his length back, Ajinkya off the back foot keeps it out. A maiden to begin with by Woakes but not a threatening one.
Attacks the stumps this time. Rahane gets behind the line and blocks it.
Another delivery outside off, Rahane lets it be.
A little too wide outside off, the batsman does not play at it.
A stifled appeal but not given! Just ahead of a shorter length on middle, it comes back in. Rahane tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Shorter delivery on middle, it sticks into the surface. Rahane is early into his flick. He misses and gets hit on the body.

Time for the last session... a minimum of 32 overs left in the day. Out come Virat Kohli and Ajinkya Rahane, they will resume their innings. Probably they will be looking for some quick runs. The latter will be on strike and he will face Chris Woakes. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 3 ...

It has been a one-way traffic, just like the morning session. The only difference is India lost Pujara for 72 to Stokes. He missed a well-deserved ton but apart from that, it has been nothing but frustration for the likes of Anderson and co. Also Rashid has been pretty ordinary in this Test, not helping the cause of his team. After Pujara's dismissal, Rahane joined hands with the Indian skipper, who is currently batting on 93, and toyed with the English bowlers even more. The hosts have taken the new ball but their fortune doesn't seem to change in this Test. The last session of the day coming up in a short while, stay tuned!
Googly to finish the over and the session. Kohli defends the flighted wrong 'un outside his off stump. India lead by 438 and that's Tea on Day 3.
Loopy wide of off, Kohli gets to the pitch of the ball and drives it to cover-point for no run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Too full, wide of off, Kohli lets it be.
Faster delivery on off, Kohli defends it off the front foot.
Flighted ball outside off, driven to mid off for no run.
Adil Rashid is on.
A maiden over. On a length, on off, blocked by Rahane.
Too short and wide, Rahane gets his bat away from the line.
Broad goes wide of off pole again, Rahane lets it be.
Closer to the off stump, on a similar length, Rahane defends it.
Outside off, on a fullish length, left alone.
Ajinkya lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Shows the full face of the bat and keeps it out nicely.

FOUR! Shot! Kohli is toying with Anderson here. He is making him bowl where he could score runs. After a few shortish deliveries, Jimmy goes full, looking for LBW perhaps. But Kohli is up for it, he gets forward and clips the ball from his off stump through wide mid on. The ball races to the fence as the Indian skipper moves to 93 with which he has scored the most number of runs by an Indian captain in England. The crowd is cheering for him now. 190 runs in this Test so far. How many more?
A fullish ball, it's outside off this time. Enough room for Kohli to work it through backward point for a brace.
Shortish, targeting the grille, Virat hops and keeps it down nicely.
Outside off, left alone.
Virat has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This one goes away from Rahane and he gets beaten by the movement. Anyway, a good over for the visitors. They lead by 432 and still two and some days left.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.

FOUR! Shot! How purely has he hit that? Class! Broad bowls a length ball around off and makes it to move in. Rahane encounters the movement and then clips it through square leg. Beautiful timing he gets on it and the ball races to the fence. Elegant!
On middle and off, nicely defended by Rahane.
Outside off, left alone.
Broad is making the new ball do the talking. He lands this just outside off, offering Rahane a shot. He goes for it only to get beaten by the away movement.
Wide outside off, Virat lets it be. It's a good contest between the two guys best in the business.
In that channel of uncertainty, moving away after landing around off. VK looks to defend it away from his body but fails to do so.
Outside off, left alone.
Some extra bounce for Anderson. Kohli rides it out nicely and works it to third man with an angled bat for a brace.
Full ball, on a driveable length, Kohli goes after it only to get an inside edge onto his pad. Anderson is disappointed as usual.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Extra bounce again. Rahane looks to block it but gets hit on his thigh pad after missing the line of it.
A touch fuller, driven to mid on for nothing.

Ouch! That will sting in this cold Nottingham afternoon. Broad serves it on a length and makes it to bounce a tad more. Rahane was on the front foot to defend it but the extra bounce means the ball hits him on his glove straight on.
Similar line and length from Stuart.
Rahane lunges forward and keeps it out.
Broad bowls a short of a length ball around off, Kohli plays it to the off side and changes strike.
A touch short around off, punched to point for a run.
Kohli shoulders arms to let that one through.
Ooh! Agonizingly close to the edge. Virat plays with fire. Anderson bowls another peach, enticing Kohli with a forward defense who does exactly that but fails to put bat to ball.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Similar length, a bit closer to the pole. Kohli does not fiddle with it.
A gentle length ball outside off, Kohli leaves it for the keeper.
Once again Rahane presses forward to a full ball and blocks it to the off side.

Lands it on a full length outside off, Rahane leans forward and pushes it towards covers. A loud scream of noooo follows. Calling has been loud and clear between the Indian batsmen in this innings. We saw that particularly during the last partnership between Pujara and Kohli.
Serves a good length ball just outside off, holding its line, Rahane shoulders arms.
Full in length and angling in around off, Rahane draws forward, brings his bat in front of the front pad, then allows the ball to come to him and blocks.
Outside off, left alone.
James Anderson was seen complaining about the ball to one of the umpires in between the overs. Clearly looking unhappy about something.
Inswinger to begin with. The line though is too straight. Kohli works it off his pads to long leg and crosses.
As expected, Stuart Broad to share the second new cherry from the other end. Three slips in place...
This one is angled in around off, shaping away a bit after landing, Kohli stays back to play at it with soft hands. Works it in the gap at point and takes a single.
Make it five leaves in a row. Anderson persists with his line outside off, playing on Kohli's patience. The Indian skipper is unperturbed and lets it be.
Nice delivery. He is getting closer to the off stump with every passing ball. Still not close enough to make the batsman play. Kohli currently is content in making the leave.
Anderson hurls across a good length ball outside off, shaping away, Kohli takes a long stride forward to cover his stumps before leaving it.
A hint of outswing on this delivery but it's pitched wide outside off. Kohli makes another easy leave.
First delivery is in the corridor outside off, Kohli allows it through.

Second new ball will be available now. Are England taking it? The new ball will move but it will be hard and good for stroke making as well. Lead is 422. Joe Root has decided to take the new cherry. James Anderson is handed over the nut. But it seems he is unhappy with it.
Allows the ball to spin back in and then taps it towards short leg.
Strides forward to a full ball and defends it solidly.
FOUR! What an incredible shot! It was all about finding the gap. Rahane times his flick exceedingly well and beats mid-wicket to find the fence. Class!
Strides forward to a full ball and blocks it safely.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Loopy and around leg, Rahane defends it off his pads to short leg.
Joe Root is into the attack again.
Flatter and shorter on off, Kohli goes back and hits it towards cover-point.
Floated and on off, Virat presses forward in defense.
Whoa! Is Ashwin watching? That spun square. Rashid lands it wide outside off, turning away viciously, Kohli flashes and misses. So much spin that Stokes at first slip catches it.
Quicker one, full and around off, Kohli gets forward and defends it off the inside half of the bat.
Flighted and on leg, staying low, Rahane gets back and works it through square leg for a single.
Tossed up ball on middle, Rahane defends it off his front foot.
Good length ball on off, angling back in, Kohli covers the line and defends it right under his watchful eyes.
Another flick shot, this time from a different batsman but the result is the same. A single.
Stokes is on the shorter side this time. A bit slower in pace too. Kohli goes back and helps it through square leg for a single.
Once again Ben puts it on a driving length outside off, Virat drives again but this time finds the cover fielder.

FOUR! Shot of a batsman in prime form! Stokes overpitches it outside off, Kohli strides forward and plays his trademark punchy-drive through covers. Right through the gap it goes and reaches the fence in no time.
Stokes serves it on a length just around off, staying low now, hmm... Kohli keeps his eyes on the ball and blocks it to the off side.
Flighted ball, landing very full on middle, Ajinkya sweeps it through square leg for a couple of runs.
Rahane has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Knocks a full ball down through mid off for a single.
FOUR! A leg spinner landing on the leg stump line, Kohli rocks back and plays a thunderous pull shot over mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted and on off, Kohli defends it off his front foot.
Tossed up ball on middle, defended.

Drinks break. Another hour which has belonged to India, though England managed to see the back of Cheteshwar Pujara. This match has reached that stage where everyone will be thinking about one thing, when will India declare? They already have a lead in excess of 400 and are bossing this game. Virat Kohli is approaching his century and maybe that's the one thing they would like their skipper to achieve before putting England to bat again.
A rising delivery around off, Kohli goes on his toes and taps it down through point for a single.
Bends his back to bowl it short and outside off. Kohli chooses to let it go unplayed.
A length ball angling into the batsman, Kohli plants his front foot forward and drives it off the inner half of the bat to mid on.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Virat lets it through.

Four leg byes! Takes the lead past the 400-run mark. Stokes delivers it down the leg side, Kohli fails to flick it but the ball still kisses his pads and runs past the keeper for a boundary at fine leg.
A fielder on the hook for Virat Kohli.
Angling down the leg side, it's played off the pads in front of square leg for a single.
Quicker through the air on middle, Rahane once again goes on the back foot and works it wide of mid on for a run.
Rahane reads the googly well, goes on the back foot and punches it towards wide mid on.
Flatter, quicker and shorter. Around middle and Rahane helps it down to fine leg for a couple. Cook is there in the deep, an unusual position for him to field.
The batsman has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
Spin and bounce outside off, it's left alone by Virat.

Tossed up ball outside off, Kohli reaches out for it and mistimes his drive to covers. He got out playing a similar shot in the first innings. The Indian skipper using more of a flat bat here than the angled one to avoid edging. It's all about learning from your mistake.
Bouncer outside off this time, pretty harmless, Rahane drops his wrists and allows it through.
Angles in a length ball on off, Rahane defends it off his back foot to the leg side.
Shortish this time, on middle and leg, Kohli glances it behind square leg and Rashid speeds across to his left from fine leg to restrict the batsmen to just one.
Stokes darts in a bouncer, Kohli ducks.

Good length ball angling into the batsman, extra bounce again as Kohli defends it from the higher half of his bat. There's something in this pitch for the bowlers who are willing to put in some extra effort.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Once again Rahane is on the front foot as he blocks it to the off side.
A leg spinner landing full around off, Rahane prods forward and defends it on the off side.
Leans forward and dead bats it with the spin to the off side.
Quicker and flatter, landing around off and skidding  back in, Rahane goes deep inside the crease and blocks.
Flighted delivery, landing full outside off, Rahane draws forward and defends it solidly.
Sliding down the leg side, Rahane clips it to fine leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Fullish and on off, Rahane drives it off his front foot to mid off. Great timing. Meanwhile, the floodlights are switched on.

Ajinkya Rahane walks in next at number 5. Thought India might look to experiment with Hardik Pandya or Rishabh Pant with plenty of runs already on the board. These two can score briskly too. Maybe, the tourists want to keep it plain and simple for now. Fair enough, too much time left in this Test match.

OUT! Finally England taste some success today. Stokes is the one to provide the breakthrough and break the 113-run stand. He delivers it on a length just outside off and gets it to nip back in with extra bounce. Pujara tries defending it without much footwork and gets a fat outside edge behind. Cook at first slip takes it easily. Pujara is disappointed, there was a century for the taking. Anyway, India are right on top, leading by 392 runs.
Good speed from Stokes but no direction. He once again serves it down the leg side, Pujara fails to get any bat on it.
Short in length and angling down the leg side, Kohli glances it off his hips to deep backward square leg for a run.
Ben Stokes is back on.
Loopy and outside off, turning away, Pujara takes his front leg forward to cover the line and then leaves it.
A googly again, slower through the air but it's on the shorter side. Pujara goes deep inside the crease and plays it down to point.
Tossed up and wide outside off, left alone.
FOUR! Rashid has struggled to bowl to a consistent length. This time he bowls it short and gets pulled to deep mid-wicket for a boundary.
Flighted and full outside off, Pujara strides to defend but it spins back just a bit to catch the inside edge. It rolls wide of forward short leg.
Shorter delivery on middle, Kohli punches it off his back foot to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and outside off, 135 kph, Pujara drives it off his front foot to point.
Bangs it in short, Pujara allows it through by ducking.
Full and on middle, Kohli strides forward and drives it down the ground. It speeds past Anderson at mid on and they take three runs.
Fullish and on middle, Kohli gets forward and forces it down to mid on.
Lands it on a length and around middle, Pujara works it down to fine leg for a run.
On a good length and around off, Pujara covers the line and defends it to the off side.
Too full this time, on middle, it's been eased away through mid-wicket for a run.
Rashid once again drags his length back and serves it on middle, Kohli goes back and hits it to deep mid-wicket for one.
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and flicks it wide of mid on for a single.
Shorter and on off, punched from the back foot to covers.
Played to the mid-wicket region by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Quicker full ball on off, Kohli gets forward to drive but gets it away off the outside edge. It rolls towards point.
Lands it on a length and in the channel outside off, Pujara shoulders arms.
Pujara picked that bouncer early and let it through to the keeper.
Lands it full and around off, Pujara slices his attempted drive towards the point fielder.
Goes on the back foot to a length ball and blocks it safely.

Huge shout for a catch! Umpire Erasmus remains unmoved. Woakes with an inswinger landing on a length around off. It nips back in as Pujara tries to defend it with his bat and pad put together. The ball goes behind off something, there is a certain noise, and Buttler jumps in join after collecting the ball. They appeal but to no avail. England opt not to take the DRS. The Snicko detects some spike, not sure whether it's bat first or pad. Simultaneous action.
Good length ball on off, angling in, Pujara stays inside the crease and defends.
Slower through the air, full and on off, Kohli defends it watchfully to the off side.
Flighted and on off, defended safely.
Kohli has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Spinning away from the batsman, outside off, Kohli has nothing to do with it.
Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, Virat strides forward and defends it near his front pad.
Loopy and full outside off, a full-blooded cover drive by Pujara and he immediately call for two. But the fielder in the deep is quickly to the ball and India's number 3 has to satisfy with a single.
Breaking news - Jonny Bairstow has sustained a small fracture to his left middle finger. Big blow.
Hurls in a length ball in the zone outside off, Virat let it be to end the over.
Digs in a short ball outside off, Kohli stands back on his toes and taps it down to covers.
Lands it on a fuller length outside off, Kohli draws forward to drive it through the line. But it comes off the inner half and rolls towards mid off.
On a good length and wide outside off, Kohli stays back and shoulders arms.
Beaten all ends up! Beautiful delivery. It lands on a length just outside off, straightening a touch off the seam, Kohli is forward to defend but is beaten.
Gets forward and drives it through covers for a couple of runs.
Lunges to defend but it takes the inside half of the bat and rolls wide of forward short leg.
Skidding off the surface, from the middle stump line, Kohli hangs back and helps it through mid-wicket for one.
Spin and bounce wide outside off, Kohli allows it through.
Short this time, Pujara rocks back and slaps it to sweeper cover for one.
A googly this time, landing full around off and turning back in, Pujara tries to flick but misses. A stifled appeal for an lbw but it's too high.
Tossed up ball on off, fuller in length, it's defended off the front foot to covers.
A tempting line, that. Pitches it full and outside off, going straight on after landing, Kohli lets it through to the keeper.
Another delivery dropping on a length around off, Pujara allows it to come and then works it in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Lands it on a length just around off, shaping away just a touch, Pujara remains back footed and offers a straight bat in defense.
Good length ball around off, angling in, Kohli is on the front foot as he taps it down towards point. The gully fielder moves across to his right to stop the ball and the batsmen change ends.
Delivers this one on the driving length outside off. Kohli takes a stride forward to cover the line and then shoulders arms.
Back of a length ball just around off, Kohli remains on the back foot and defends it down safely on the off side.
Loopy one, outside off, spinning away, Pujara leaves it to end the over.

FOUR! Short again and this time punished. Rashid struggling with his length, probably. Serves a half-tracker in line of the stumps, Pujara immediately goes deep inside the crease and pulls it powerfully through mid-wicket.
Tossed up and in the channel outside off, Che has an easy leave.
Rashid pulls his length back and bowls it around off, Pujara goes on the back foot and punches it down towards mid on.
This one is very full and outside off, Kohli gets on the front foot and drives it wide of mid on for a single.
Flighted delivery wide outside off, spinning away, Kohli watches the line and lets it go to the keeper.
Outside off, on a length, played to point for nothing.
Hangs back and keeps it with a straight bat to the off side.
Outside off, left alone.
Jonny Bairstow is sitting in the dressing room with his fingers taped. He doesn't look too happy.
Some extra bounce on this one. It hits Pujara on his thigh pad as he fails to put bat to ball.
On the pads of Kohli. He flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a run.
Flicks the shortish ball on his hips to the on side for a run.
Chris Woakes to share the attack.
Virat has done well to keep that yorker at bay to end the over.
Shortish delivery on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for an easy run.
This one comes in straight with the angle. Che watchfuly defends it back to the bowler.
Slow, outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
A loopy delivery outside off to start with. Kohli drives it through covers and changes strike.

The post-Lunch session is about to get underway. The Kohli-Pujara pair is out in the middle to commence their innings. Adil Rashid will bowl the first over after the break. He has a short leg and slip in place for Kohli. Here we go...
... Day 3, Session 2 ...

This session can easily be put in India's basket. They have maneuvered the strike well and looked set to take the English bowlers gas out, who are already looking tired. Both Kohli and Pujara, have scored a half-century and frustrated the opposition. The pitch is getting slower by the hour as well and it will be difficult to bat on the 4th and 5th day to put it subtly. Hang around, the post-Lunch session starts in a short while.

Slow and steady wins the race - that's India's mantra it seems. Both the batters, Kohli and Pujara have been solid and watchful this morning, not giving too many chances to the opposition. There was a catch spilt by Buttler of Pujara but other than that, there is not much to show for the English bowlers in this session. One thing they have managed to do well is that they have kept a check on the run-rate and haven't allowed too many boundaries. However, the partnership between the duo has blossomed even more and it looks ever so threatening for the home team.
Flicks the flighted ball on his pad to the short mid-wicket. India lead by 362 and that's Lunch on Day 3.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.
Now Pujara plays the flatter delivery on his pad to the on side for another easy single.
On the pads, worked through mid-wicket for a run.
Wide down the leg side, No trouble at all for Kohli as he leaves it.
Kohli has flicked the ball off his pads. One run added to the total.
This one stayed a touch low. Kohli was eyeing the mid-wicket region to play the pull but it never bounced. He manages to get it to on side.
Virat shoulders arms to let that one through.
Nice leggie from Adil, Pujara looks to defend the ball on his pad but gets an inside edge. The ball goes off his inner half and they take a single.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
Flat and pushed through by Adil, CP is half forward and as a result, he gets an inside edge on to his pad. The ball then rolls past the leg pole. Luckily for him, the ball didn't hit the stumps.
A gentle full toss on the pads, Che plays it through mid-wicket uppishly and keeps strike.
Looks to charge down the ground to defend but changes his mind at the last moment. Ends up pushing it to the on side for no run.
On the pads, easily flicked through the on side for another single.
Kohli plants his front foot down the ground and defends the flatter ball with a full face of the bat.
Similar delivery on middle and leg, played through mid-wicket for a run.
Root starts his over from 'round the wicket. CP defends it under his eyes off the front foot.
Joe Root comes in for a bowl. Desperate times call for desperate measures.
Slower, loopy, on off, Kohli lunges forward and defends it.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.
Goes back in his crease to play the shortish ball through covers for a run.
Flatter in line of the stumps, easily blocked again.
Gets forward and defends it nicely under his eyes.
Loopy outside off, Che leaves it.
On a length, easily blocked out by Virat.
Outside off, left alone.
Full on off, driven to covers for no run.
Back of a length outside off, played to point.
Kohli lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out off the front foot.
Similar kind of ball and shot to end the over.
Outside off this time, Pujara plays it to point.
Slower one around middle, Pujara gets hit on his pad and the ball lobs in the air. No bat involved so no harm done.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.

Now Kohli gets to his 19th Test fifty as well. Both the batters looking good, well settled and in for a longer innings. He punches this flighted ball to the on side and runs one. He soaks in the applause from the crowd and his teammates. He would love to convert this one into a three-figure one, for the sake of his stats and his team.
Flighted on off, Che drives it to covers and changes strike.

That's FIFTY for Pujara, his 18th in the longest format and a much-needed one. He flicks this fuller ball to the on side and takes the single to complete the milestone. Coincidentally, the last half century he scored away from home in the second innings was on this same ground (in 2014). He would love to take this track back with him, wouldn't he?
Fullish ball on off, Pujara defend it down the track for no run.
Che chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Outside off, on a length, played to point for a run.
Shortish on Kohli's hips who tucks it to the vacant deep backward square leg region and takes a brace.
The ball is way outside the off stump, easy leave for Cheeku.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.

Almost a similar shot and ball to his first innings dismissal. That time he edged it to first slip. This time Kohli goes with soft hands and gets it through backward point region. Three quick runs are taken and Kohli applauds his partner.
Slow, full, driven through covers for a run.
Shows the full face and keeps out the flatter ball to the off side.
Another loopy ball in line of the stumps, Che pushes it off the front foot.
Flighted full ball on off, pushed back to the bowler.

FOUR! Geez, that was so agonizingly close to the off pole. An effort ball from Broad around off. Kohli goes after it with hard hands and gets a thick inside edge. The ball races to the fine leg fence, not convincingly though.
Similar delivery from Broad, Kohli pushes it through cover-point and takes a brace.

FOUR! That is four, that is for certain. Talk about batting beautifully, and look at that shot. A solid extension of the arms and the ball races through covers off Kohli's bat. A full ball outside off and it was all too easy for him to put away.
Swinging in to Kohli and going down the leg side. He tries to flick it but misses.
Goes back to the basics again and leaves the short of a length ball for the keeper.
Goes fishing after the wide one. An unncessary loose shot from Kohli. Good thing for him, he missed it.
On the stumps, kept out.
FOUR! Too short and too wide and it has been put away. Easy pickings for a batsman who plays spin really well. Pujara goes back and slaps it through cover-point for a boundary.
The slider from Rashid on off, Pujara gets behind the line and blocks it.
Loopy ball outside off, Che shoulders arms to it.
A poor delivery, short and outside off, Pujara does not play at it.
Starts off with a googly which Kohli picks, he turns it towards square leg for a run. The 50-run stand is up.
Adil Rashid is on.
Just outside off, Pujara looks to defend it but misses. So, end of an exciting over after ages. Well, it felt that way to be honest.
A tweet from ECB says that Jonny is going for an X-Ray on his left middle finger. England will hope there is no fracture. Bairstow will be needed big time with the bat in this Test.
Full again on middle and leg, Che flicks it through mid-wicket for an easy brace.
Fullish on the pads, Kohli flicks it and changes strike.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out under his eyes.

NOT OUT! Did Kohli make England waste a review here? Well, my colleague here thinks so. It was an inswinging length ball around off. Kohli came forward to defend but failed to put bat to ball. The ball raps him on his pad and an appeal ensued. Broad cries out loud but the umpire is unmoved. After a bit of a discussion, Root goes upstairs. The replays suggest that the ball took an inside edge before hitting him on his pad. Clever thing here was Kohli (if intentional), never looked up to show any emotion. He could well have been laughing with his head bowed down as he knew there was a certain edge. Mind games, I tell you!
England have taken a review. Virat Kohli is the man in question. It looks to have hit high on his pad.
Nice quick single this. Kohli gets it to mid-wicket and calls Che for a quick run who obliges. A direct hit has been scored at Pujara's end but he is in.
This one is down the leg side and the batsman leaves it alone.

FOUR! Clever, very clever from the Indian skipper. His eyes lit up as he saw a short ball outside off. He calmly opened the face of the bat by getting on top of the bounce. He keeps it down and gets it to the third man fence for a boundary. It also suggests that the pitch has slowed down a tad.
Bouncer! Kohli does well to evade it.
Bowls this on a length to which Virat presents a straight bat.
Driven nicely by Kohli but good fielding at covers by Pope saved a certain boundary. He, however, failed to collect it cleanly and as a result, the batsmen take two from the extra cover region.
Outside off, Pujara lets it be.
Similar length from Stuart on middle and off, Che happy to block it.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out on the ground.
Outside off, tucked to point for no run.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through.

How many times is the ball going to evade Che's bat? It has happened countless times since morning. Broad bowls a fullish delivery around off, Pujara looks to defend it off the front foot but fails to put bat to it.
A bumper way outside off, Kohli lets it be.
On the hips, worked to the square leg region for a run.

How late did he play that? Nice reflexes. Ben cleverly darts this one in on a length from his natural angle. The ball skids off the surface and Pujara is quick enough to keep it out with a straight bat.
A short of a length ball around off to which Pujara shows an angled bat and works it to the off side.
Bouncer! Puajra ducks in time to let that one go over him.
No means no. The loudest 'NO' you'll hear in Trent Bridge. Virat plays the full ball on middle through mid-wicket and runs a single. Virat wanted a second but Pujara shouts 'NO' for the second one.
Too wide to entice Pujara with a shot. Broad ends a wayward first over of his spell.
Nicely left by CP. A length ball just outside off.
The batsman chooses to leave the ball outside his off stump.
Drags his length back a tad, makes Pujara go back and defend it.
Another full ball on off, Che pushes it to mid off for no run.
Broad starts his spell with a full delivery wide outside off. Virat pushes it through covers and changes strike.
Stuart Broad comes on.
Another play and a miss! Good length outside off, Pujara hangs his bat out and gets beaten. Maiden for Stokes.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
The inswinger on off, Pujara pushes it to mid off.
Back of a length again on off, Pujara keeps it out.
A bumper on off, Pujara stands tall and defends it.
Outside off, left alone.

Jonny Bairstow is now going off the field to receive some treatment. The responsibility of keeping will be passed on to Jos Buttler. The advantage of having two keepers in your side... Also, Jamie Potter is on the field as a substitute for him.

OUCH! Anderson lands it on a length around off, Pujara leaves it. It tails back in after passing the batsman. Bairstow fails to collect it cleanly as it rolls towards the leg side. The batsmen run a bye. Jonny is down in pain as it might have hit the top of his finger. Very painful that.
Wide outside off, the batsman does not play at it.
A well-directed bouncer this time. Pujara ducks under it.
On a length around off, Che is half forward as he defends it to the off side.
On middle, Kohli tries to defend but it goes off the inside edge down to fine leg for a run.
Wide outside off, Kohli leaves it.
Short now of the slip fielder! Nothing going England's way! Back of a length on off, the ball straightens. Pujara pokes at it and gets an outside edge which falls just short of third slip.
The bumper but once agian it comes really slow off the surface. Pujara evades it.
On the off pole, Pujara pushes it to mid on.

Pujara goes fishing there and luckily for him, it does not take the edge. He tries to play away from his body and it whizzes past the outside edge. He is not happy with himself as he knows that can be left.
Back of a length on off, Che pushes it to point.
Lovely stuff! On a length around off, it pitches, bounces a touch extra and also moves away. Pujara tries to block it but is beaten.
Outside off, left alone.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Well bowled! Another one of those outswingers which pitches on off and then shapes away. Kohli does not account for the movement as he plays inside the line and gets beaten.
On a length and around off, Kohli defends it solidly to point.
Outside off, this one stays low. Kohli leaves it and JB collects it on the bounce.
A huge shout but not given! The inswinger from outside off, Kohli plants his front foot forward and tries to defend. He gets an inside edge onto his pads.

A little too straight, Kohli nudges it through square leg and gets to the other end. 34 is what the partnership is between the two. They have gone about it at a slow rate as they have chewed up 106 deliveries.
On a length and outside off, Kohli like he has been doing through out the series, does not go fetching.
On the pads, Pujara tucks it around the corner and takes a run.

Was there an edge? Well there was a noise but nobody appealed! The sucker ball almost does the trick there, full and very wide outside off. Pujara goes for a drive away from his body but luckily for him the ball misses the edge. Not sure what the noise was.
Down the leg side, Pujara tries to flick but misses.
Shorter in length on off, VK guides it through point for a run.
Ben Stokes is into the attack.
Outside off again, CP shoulders arms to it. End of an over which could have been a wicket-maiden.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Wide outside off, Pujara lets it be.
Continuous bowling length on off, Pujara blocks it.

EDGED AND DROPPED! The slip catching has not been great for England in this game, in this series I should say and here is an example. Yes, it was a difficult chance but they need to hang on as they need wickets. Anderson this time induces the edge as he bowls it on off and gets it to straighten. Pujara half-heartedly tries to defend but the ball takes the outside edge and goes low in between first and second slip. Buttler from the latter position puts out his left hand and tries to catch it but can't hang on. A life for Pujara, this is the luck you need when you are out of form. Pujara would now want to make England pay big time.
Tucks it with the angle to the man at mid on.
Another loopy bouncer outside off, Kohli lets it be.
A bumper but it comes very slow off the surface. Kohli watches it go through to the keeper.
Crisply driven but finds the fielder! Full on off, Kohli strokes it to covers.
Back of a length around middle, this one pitches and comes back in. Kohli tries to flick but misses to get hit high on the pads.
Wide outside off, left alone.

FOUR! Full marks to the bowler but runs to the batsman. A good delivery, full and swinging away from middle, Kohli tries to work it across the line but closes the bat face a touch early. It takes the leading edge, goes past the diving cover fielder and into the fence. Woakes can't believe it but such are the bats nowadays.
The batsman shoulders arms to let that one through. So, runs have not come easy for the Indian batters today.
Very good from James Anderson. However, it is frustrating for him that it is beating the edge. On a length around off, it pitches and straightens. Pujara plays inside the line and gets beaten.
A surprise change in length, a bumper on middle, Pujara though has a lot of time to duck under it.
A little too wide outside off, Pujara does not bother putting bat to ball.
Good length on off, Pujara is half forward as he defends it on the ground.
FOUR! Into the 40s now is Pujara! On his pads, Pujara says thank you so much as he flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball races away.
Not bowled on the stumps and Kohli doesn't need to fiddle with it.
Goes wide this time, wanting Kohli to play a loose stroke. He resists and lets it be.
Nicely played! Slightly fuller on off, Kohli leans into it and times it through covers. The batsmen run two.
On middle, Kohli keeps it out.
This one stays a touch low! Pitches on off and just never takes off. Kohli gets his bat down in time and keeps it out.
Good length and outside off, Kohli does not need to play at those.
Outside off, the batsman need not play at those.
Back of a length on off, Pujara guides it to point.
Length outside off, left alone.
Another good leave! On a length and outside off, comes back in. Pujara covers his off pole and points his bat skywards.
Slightly straighter, Kohli goes back and tucks it to fine leg for a run. The lead is now 300.
Down the leg side, Kohli misses the flick and it goes into the hands of the keeper.
On the stumps, Pujara pushes it towards wide mid on. He wants a run but Kohli sends him back. Good early call by the skipper, run outs are not something they would want.
Woakes now bowls the off cutter on off, it comes back in. Pujara tries to defend but it goes off the inner half towards mid-wicket.
Again, just as I was saying, he gets behind the line of this one and defends it on the ground solidly.

On off and shaping away just a little, Pujara shoulders arms to it. He has looked really confident in this innings of his. Leaving the ball well and also defending it by getting right behind the line.
Fuller on middle, Pujara with the angle works it towards wide mid on. Broad there misfields and concedes an extra run.
Lands it on a length around middle, CP blocks.

A beauty to end an excellent over by Anderson! He is getting the ball to move both ways. The outswinger on the 6th ball. Pitches on off and leaves the batsman. Kohli prods forward and tries to keep it out but gets beaten. Not a lot you can do on such deliveries, just have to hope it misses the edge.
The batsman defends it from within the crease.
The off cutter, Anderson bringing out all his variations here. It pitches and jags back into Kohli. He tries to defend but gets an inside edge onto his pads.
Another inswinger, Pujara tries to defend but gets it off the inner half towards square leg for his first run today.
Lovely stuff from Anderson! The last ball came in and this one leaves Pujara after pitching on off. Che is forward to defend but the ball whizzes past the outside edge.

OHHHH! Good leave there by Pujara. Anderson comes steaming in and bowls it around off, gets it to shape back in and also bounce after pitching. Pujara does really well to leave it by taking his gloves out of the way.
Another ball outside off, Kohli need not play at those.
Goes wide outside off now, Kohli makes a leave.

FOUR! First runs today! Woakes tries to ping Kohli on the pads but it is Virat's strong point. He flicks it through mid-wicket and the ball trickles to the fence. This is also Kohli's 200th boundary in second innings.
Good length around off, Kohli lunges and defends it.
No swing again and probably a loosener from Woakes. It is bowled at 128 Kph. Kohli flicks it to mid-wicket.
Woakes goes fuller in search of some swing but does not find any. Kohli works it to mid on.
Chris Woakes to bowl from the other end.
Slightly outside off, Pujara leaves it. End of a tight first over by Anderson.
The inswinger this time but it is slightly short. Pujara has time to adjust as he tucks it to mid-wicket with the swing.
Once again hits the length hard on off, CP blocks it.
Lands it in the similar area as the last delivery but does not get it to move. Pujara guides it to point.

BEAUTY! Pace, bounce and some movement! Bends his back on this one and lands it on off, this one pitches and then moves away. Pujara has to play at it due to the original trajectory but gets beaten by the away movement.
Right on the money first up! On a length and around off, no movement visible. Pujara off the back foot pushes it to the man at covers.

We are all set for the action to begin. Out come Cheteshwar Pujara and Virat Kohli to resume their innings. The former will be on strike and he will face James Anderson who will start the proceedings. He has three slips in place. Here we go...

Pitch report - Sanjay Manjrekar says there are a few rough patches on both the sides. Reckons it would have been more helpful for the left-arm spinner. Ends by saying the conditions overhead plays a huge role in how the pitch behaves.

England on the other hand, will hope for an Indian batting collapse, if they are to have a chance in this game. Once again, their pacers will hold the key for them. Will they wreck havoc or will the Indian batsman continue from where they left off yesterday? Stay tuned to find out.

Hello and welcome to the third day of the third Test between England and India. The visitors are in the driver's seat and they probably have a chance to bat the hosts out of the game. They still have 8 wickets in hand and with Kohli and Pujara, who looked in sublime touch yesterday, they will surely be trying to do so.
... Day 3, Session 1 ...
That's it from our side. We will be back on Day 3 with the visitors starting the day in a commanding position. Do join us then at 1100 local (1000 GMT). Till then, ciao.

Hardik Pandya gives a quick interview. He is delighted after picking a fifer. Feels that his batsmen batted superbly in the first innings and informs that post-lunch they decided to bowl in the right areas consistently. Further adds that the plan was to choke the run flow as the wickets weren't coming initially. Says that he is not afraid to get driven as it also gives him the chance to pick up wickets when the ball is moving. On the wicket of Woakes, he mentions that it was a plan to bowl short as he was told that Chris has got out a few times in the past against such deliveries. Signs off by saying that he doesn't care what people say about him and he has the backing of his team which is more important.

For the Men in Blue, all the bowlers did a commendable job as for the first time in this series they had the opposition on the mat. Bumrah, Ishant and Shami got their names in the wickets column as well and helped restrict England to just 161. They were relentless in their approach as the home team lost 9 wickets in a space of mere 74 runs. Buttler's T20-style heroics reduced the deficit but still, India ended up getting a handy 168-run lead.

Earlier in the day, Pant along with Ashwin came in to bat on an overcast morning. They couldn't do much as the remaining four wickets were removed by the Broad-Anderson duo. India could only add 22 runs to their overnight score, however, it looked more than enough on this Trent Bridge track. In reply, Cook and Jennings did rush to a 50-run opening stand, but afterwards, it was a one-way traffic. Pandya, the bowling star, ran through the middle order on his way to his maiden 5-fer in Tests. In the due process, 16 wickets were lost in the day (India - 6, England - 10).

What a day of cricket we have had. The team from the subcontinent will be elated with the position they find themselves in at the end of the day's play. Their batters have made sure that their already advantageous position is solidified even more in the last session. Just like the first innings, Dhawan and Rahul stitched a 50-run stand, and the latter lost his wicket at exactly the same score. After that, Pujara and Dhawan played cautiously before the southpaw got stumped out on 44 to Rashid. Afterwards, the Indian skipper along with Pujara played for Stumps.
And it's another easy leave outside the off stump for Kohli. That will be Stumps on Day 2 and India lead by 292.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out. Last ball of the day coming up.
Another short ball and another easy leave for Kohli.
Some chin music for Kohli from the Ginger Devil, he lets that bouncer through to the wicket-keeper.
Virat lets the ball go outside his off stump.
Short ball targeting the grille of Kohli. He does well to defend it nicely.

Peach! Luck isn't going England's way today. Jimmy bowls another length ball just outside off, it lands and comes back in sharply. Good thing on Pujara's part is that he played the line and didn't go after it. That's probably the reason he didn't nick it.
Tired Anderson bowls a length ball on off which Pujara defends easily.
Che has no interest in playing the deliveries outside his off stump.
Closer to the off pole, Pujara defends it under his eyes.
On a length around off, left alone by Che.
Short outside off, Pujara keeps it down with an angled bat.
Short and wide outside off, Kohli leaves it.
Bouncer! The batsman ducks under the bouncer at the last moment.

Stifled appeal for a catch! Stokes sends across a sharp short ball around leg, Kohli takes on the challenge to hook it but fails to connect. Bairstow gets his hands up to collect the ball but before doing so, he starts to appeal. Soon he realizes that it has popped out and he dives back to recollect it. Fails. The replays later on detect nothing.

Nearly falls prey to the plan. Stokes bends his back and delivers a short ball on off. Kohli gets into a bit of a tangle while playing at it and somehow keeps it out. It goes uppishly towards mid-wicket, wide of the forward short leg fielder.
A bouncer around off, an easy leave for the Indian skipper.
Shortish on off, Kohli goes on his toes and glances it behind square leg for a couple.
Much better. Anderson continues to probe outside off. A back of a length ball, holding its line, Pujara shoulders arms.
Shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.

Gets lured there, Che. Anderson persists with his line outside off, a touch short in length, Pujara has a lazy waft at it and misses. After attempting that shot, he looks down. Maybe, trying to gather his composure.
Another delivery quite wide outside off, Pujara again lets it be.
In the channel outside off, Pujara will leave it untouched.

Anderson runs in with the sun behind his back. He delivers a length ball on off, it goes straight on without much movement and Kohli defends it with ease from the back foot. The ball rolls towards point and they cross.
A bit short and on middle, Kohli stands tall and works it down to fine leg for one.
Digs in a short ball around middle and off, Kohli moves away from the line with ease as he crouches.
Back of a length ball on middle, Pujara turns it through square leg for a run.
Another bouncer by Stokes, Pujara has sensed the plan, not trying to be a daredevil this time like his last innings. Ducks.
A leg gully comes in.
That's the ball! A well-directed bouncer. Pujara does well to keep his eyes on the ball initially and then sways away from the line of fire.
Looking at the field, the ploy seems to be to soften up Pujara with some short stuff. So far, Stokes has been wayward though with his line. A short delivery down the leg side, easily left by Pujara.
Edgy! Another inswinger, only difference from the last delivery is that it curled in while reaching the batsman. Kohli gets forward to defend and does so from the inside edge.
Good length delivery in the channel outside off, Kohli covers the line and movement before shouldering arms. There was some inward movement after it went past the batsman.
A length ball angling into the batsman, Pujara once again remains inside the crease and then closes the face of his bat to work it through mid-wicket. An easy run.
Looked like a slower delivery. It landed a touch short and around off, Pujara stayed back footed as he defended it to the off side.
Delivers it on a length and wide outside off, Virat reaches out for it and steers it through point to get off strike.
Good length ball on middle and off, Kohli has the line covered as he blocks it back.
James Anderson is back on.
A bouncer this time by Stokes, Pujara sways away. End of a wayward over by Ben.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region. One run added to the total.
Another delivery too straight in line, Pujara tucks it through mid-wicket and rotates the strike.
Not the line to bowl. On the pads and Virat just clips it towards long leg for an easy run.
Right then, it's time for Stokes vs Kohli...
Goes full this time, on middle, Pujara easily flicks it through backward square leg and collects a single.
Wrong line first up. A gentle loosener, on a length and drifting down the leg side, Pujara tries to flick initially and then pulls his bat away.
Ben Stokes is back on after an extended spell by Woakes.
Flatter and on middle, helped in the gap on the leg side for one.
Big spin there after it lands outside off. Pujara lets it through to the keeper. Ashwin will be watching this with great interest.
Sliding down the leg side, Kohli helps it behind square leg and gets off the mark with a single.
Full and flighted on off, driven back to the bowler.
Skipper Virat Kohli walks in next.

OUT! Against the run of play, Dhawan is stumped. He has a wry smile on his face as he walks back to the pavilion. Beautiful bowling by Rashid. He has outfoxed the Indian opener with a well-disguised wrong 'un. Dhawan runs down the track without reading the variation, is deceived in flight first and then tries to defend it. But to his bad luck, it's a googly, turning away from his blade. Bairstow does the stumping easily. Shikhar misses out on his maiden Test fifty in England. Anyway, a fine knock. India lead by 279 runs.
Turning down the leg side, Dhawan goes on the back foot and tickles it with the spin to fine leg for a brace.
Watchful again. It's in the corridor of uncertainty, Pujara lets it through to the keeper.

Aahh...that temptation. Pujara shows a truck-load of patience there. Woakes bowls it short and wide outside off, Che stays back, watches the line closely, flashing at it did cross his mind but he stays put and allows it through.
Angles in a length ball on off, Pujara presents a dead straight bat in defense.
And again. Woakes continues to be straighter in his line, Dhawan manoeuvres it through square leg for one.
FOUR! This time on the leg stump line to the left-hander, Dhawan picks it off his pads and neatly deflects it to the fine leg fence. Struggling with his line, Woakes.
Wrong line, on a length and angling down the leg side, Pujara nudges it to fine leg and takes a single.
Rashid changes his angle for the southpaw and bowls a leg spinner, Dhawan allows it to spin back in and then plays it out to the leg side. Not in the gap.
Rashid drags his length back this time and serves it around off, Pujara pushes himself on the back foot and punches it towards covers. The ball rolls in the gap and they switch ends.
A googly this time, landing on full and curling back in, Che is on the front foot in defense and does so from the inner half of the bat.
Pujara has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Full flighted on off, spinning away, Pujara takes his front leg outside the line of the stumps and then pads it away. Bairstow lets out an ambitious appeal.
Gets down the track to take it on the full and drives it straight to covers.
Shortish and on off, Dhawan eases himself on the back foot and blocks it down safely.
Angling across the batsman, outside off, Dhawan shoulders arms.
This one is very full and around off, Dhawan gets forward and defends it back.
Sliding down the leg side, Pujara fails to flick and it goes off his pads to fine leg. The bowler appeals and the batsmen cross for a run. Leg bye given. Missing leg.

Huge shout for a caught behind! Not given. There was some sound though. An outswinger, landing on a length around off, Pujara tries playing the line but it nips away to beat the outside edge. They appeal after Bairstow collects the ball but nothing doing. Joe looks at his keeper who isn't too convinced. They didn't take the DRS as a result. The replays later on show that the noise was of the bat brushing the pads.
Back of a length ball on off, angling in, Pujara keeps his weight on the back foot and punches it in front of square on the off side. Straight to the fielder. Looking quite good with his footwork.
Tossed up ball on off, Dhawan is forward in defense and it goes off the outer half of the bat to point.
Flatter and shorter just outside off, Dhawan rocks back to cut but fails to time his shot.
Slower through the air and spinning down after landing on middle, Che flicks it behind square leg for a single.
Floated full ball on off, Pujara presses forward and defends it watchfully.
Too full and around off, Dhawan walks forward and bunts it to the left side of the mid off fielder for a brisk run. The crowd applauds as India complete 100 runs, thereby taking their lead to 268.
Loopy and full on middle, Dhawan sits down on one knee and sweeps it to fine leg for a couple.
Extra bounce this time, on a length and coming back into the batsman, Pujara goes on his toes and blocks it on the leg side.
On a good length close to off stump, Che sticks back and mistimes his cut shot to covers.
Another watchful leave outside the off stump by Pujara. He has looked a lot at ease in the middle. In the first innings as well, he was positive but fell to a reckless shot.
Bowls it full and wide outside off, holding its line, Pujara lets it through easily.
Short of a length ball again, angling away from the southpaw, this time Shikhar rocks back and punches it wide of mid off for a run.

DROPPED BY COOK! A repeat shot of the first innings but then he was caught. Woakes with a back of a length ball around off, it's angled across and Dhawan tries playing inside the line from the back foot. But he ends up nicking it behind where Cook puts down a sitter. Nothing going England's way as the sun continues to shine on India.
A full toss on the pads this time. Pujara flicks it through mid-wicket and takes a brace.
Outside off, slower, left alone watchfully by Pujara.
Shortish from Rashid. Not the kind of bowling you'd expect from the leggie. He is spilling runs. Dhawan pulls it with disdain but just for a single.
Dhawan has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
Another tossed up ball around off, Pujara drives it through covers and changes strike.
Flighted delivery on leg, Dhawan works it to the on side for an easy single.
Copy-paste stuff from the bowler and the batsman.
A back of a length ball on off, Pujara presents the full face once again and keeps it out.
Outside off, left alone.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets behind the line of this one and defends it.
Full and wide, Dhawan goes after it with hard hands and gets a thick inside edge. The ball goes through square leg for a run.

FOUR! Pujara in 'punisher mode'. A gentle losener from Rashid, a shortish delivery in line of the stumps, Pujara goes back and punches it past the bowler for another boundary. End of a good over for India.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Similar kind of a ball from Adil, Pujara looks to cut it again but gets beaten this time.
FOUR! A lot of width for a player like Pujara and needs no second invitation to go after it. He rocks back and cuts it through backward point for a boundary.
Slower and flighted outside off, defended.
Shortish ball to start with on leg, Dhawan flicks it to get to the other end. The lead swells to 250 now.
Adil Rashid comes in to roll his arm over after the break.
That's a much-needed break for the English bowlers. They need to regroup and get their act right soon. India is running away with the game at the moment.
Drinks...
Woakes gets too straight, Shikhar fails to flick and it goes off his pads to fine leg for a leg bye. India lead by 249.
Straight on a length. Dhawan defends with the full face of the bat.

FOUR! The stylish southpaw is growing in confidence. Not a good sign for the home side as the left hander can score runs with a healthy run rate. Woakes lands this fuller on Dhawan's pads who flicks it gracefully past the square leg fielder for a boundary. India off to a flying start.
Woakes continues with the off stump line. Pitches it on a length. Shikhar taps it down to point.
Stays back in the crease and blocks this short of a length delivery on off and middle.
Length ball on the off stump. Defended off the front foot.

FOUR! Second classy shot of the over. Stokes angles this into Pujara, fuller in length. Pujara waits for the ball to arrive and at the last moment turns his wrists and flicks it. The ball goes racing past the square leg fielder for the second boundary of the over.
Defends this straight ball on the leg side.

FOUR! BEAUTY! That is a classy straight drive from India's No. 3. Stokes goes full on off. Pujara leans forward and drives it past the bowler. The straight bat and perfect timing ensures that the ball runs down the ground for a four.
A bit shorter in length around off. Pujara pushes it to point.
Thick edge down to third man. Shikhar comes forward to defend this length ball on off. Gets an outside edge and the ball goes to third man for a single.
Stokes from round the wicket, angles this one on a length but outside off. Dhawan lets it go past.
Beats the outside edge! This one pitches on a length and moves away slightly. Pujara prods forward to defend. But the movement is enough to beat Pujara's bat.
Keeps it a bit wider of off. Pujara is not tempted to fiddle with it.
Good line and length bowling from Woakes. Pujara gets behind the line of the ball and defends solidly.
Similar line and length. Pujara lets it go.
Pujara leaves this full ball go outside his off stump.
Angles this length ball into Dhawan who works it towards square leg for a single.

Not much going for England here. Stokes keeps it short of a length on off. Pujara hangs back and looks to defends. The ball moves away and takes the outside edge. Ball flies through the vacant third man region. They run two.
Length ball on middle, pushed to mid-wicket.

FOUR! England cannot afford to leak runs. Stokes angles in this short of a length ball, it pitches and keeps coming in to Pujara who works it to fine leg with the angle. It is fine enough to cross the boundary.
Bouncer outside off, Pujara ducks under it.
Pujara is the next batsman in.

OUT! TIMBER! Stokes strikes. England needed this. He bowls it full on the off stump. Rahul goes for the drive, but does not move his feet much. The ball pitches on off and seams in ever so slightly to take the inside edge of Rahul's bat and then rattles the stumps. India lose their first on the same score they lost their first in the first innings. Nevertheless, the openers have again got them off to a solid start.
Stokes angles this into Dhawan's pads who flicks it to deep fine leg for a single.
Another appeal and the umpires is still not convinced. A length ball jagging back in sharply. Rahul looks to defend it but misses to get hit on his pads.
On the pads again, tucked to the on side for a run.
Dhawan shoulders arms to let that one through.
Inswinging full delivery in line of the stumps. KL gets hit on his pads and Dhawan calls him for a leg bye.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
On the pads of Dhawan who clips it to mid-wicket for a run.

FOUR! Lucky escape for Rahul. Stokes gets this length delivery on off to nip back prodigiously after pitching. Rahul goes for the forward defence. The classy right-hander is cut into half because of the inward movement. Ball takes the inner edge and flies to the left of diving Bairstow for a boundary.

Lands it behind a length on the off stump. The ball has the natural Stokes inward angle to it. Rahul tries to steer this into the third man region, gets cramped a bit. Ball hits his bat and trickles down to the fielder at gully.
Bumper from Stokes. Dhawan goes for the pull. Does not get it from the middle, ball goes to deep square and batsmen run two.
Fuller and attacking the stumps. Dhawan gets forwards and drives it to mid off.
Shikhar gets right behind this length ball on off and keeps it out.
Stokes starts with a full delivery angling into Rahul. He prods forward and plays it off the front foot towards covers for a single.
Ben Stokes is into the attack.

Another LBW appeal, another No Out shout by the umpire. back of a length delivery, pitches and comes into Dhawan. Ball struck the batsman on the thigh-pad. The fielding side is asking the question. The Umpire isn't interested in the appeal.
Defends this straight ball by coming right behind the line of the delivery.

Keeps it just behind the length on middle. The ball pitches and nips into Dhawan. He tries to whip it into the leg side but the inward movement beats his bat and he is struck on the thigh-pad. England appeal for a LBW but umpire is unmoved.
Woakes lands it on a length around off. Shikhar comes forward to defend. The ball holds it's line and beats the outside edge of Gabbar's bat. Lucky again.
FOUR! Cracker of a shot! Dhawan sees that the length is shorter and line is a bit wider on this one. Goes for a cut and gets it past the diving point fielder for a four.
Starts his spell with a length ball on the off stump. Dhawan gets behind the line of the ball and defends well.
Chris Woakes comes into the attack.

FOUR! KL is seeing the ball like a football now. He has thrashed the bowlers in this innings so far and he isn't done yet. Gets a full ball with a lot of width. He slaps it through cover-point and earns a handsome boundary.
Around off, on a length, defended.
Opens the face of the bat and guides this shortish ball to third man for a run.
Outside off on a length, left alone.
The batsman lets the ball go outside his off stump.
FOUR! Flashes and flashes hard for a four. A fuller ball outside off, Dhawan throws his bat at it and gets it up and over the slip cordon.
Rahul defends this straight delivery from his crease.
