FOUR! Consecutive boundaries and this one is even better. Anderson pulls his length back. Lands it just outside off. Rahul rocks back, stands tall on his toes and punches it through the cover-point region for another four.
FOUR! Rahul is looking good here. Anderson floats it a bit fuller. Rahul comes forwards and drives it past mid off and it crosses the ropes.
Shorter and straighter again, Rocks back and defends.
A bit shorter on the middle and leg line. A bit of swing away but Rahul is good enough to defend it off the back foot.
Anderson getting the ball to swing away after pitching on a length around the off stump. Rahul plays it late, close to his body and under his eyes. That's the way you defend a swinging delivery.
Bit shorter in length angled towards the body. Dhawan stands tall and defends.
Shoulders arms to this length ball outside off.
Beaten! Broad lands it just behind a length, angling in. The ball pitches and straightens. Dhawan hangs his bat and the movement beats him. Lucky it did not take the edge.
Dhawan comes forward to this full length delivery just outside off, defends it to covers.
Fuller but wider outside off. Allows him to leave it alone.
Straight delivery attacking the stumps. Ball seams into Dhawan after pitching. Hence, beating the inner edge of his bat and rapping him on his pads.
Continues with the line outside off, Dhawan continues to leave.
Dhawan has nothing to do with this length ball outside off.
Length ball around off, Dhawan comes forward and defends it to point.
Angled in delivery on a length just outside off. However, this one comes in with the around the wicket angle. Dhawan looks to defend but is beaten on the inside edge. Ball raps the thigh-pad.
Fuller and wider of off, moving away. Dhawan shoulders arms.
Starts with one that is angled in from round the wicket. The ball is wide enough from the off stump to allow Dhawan to watchful leave it.
Gets behind the line of this one and keeps it out.

FOUR! Class, pure class. He tried to play the similar kind of shot but found the fielder in the previous innings. This time he goes up and over. A shortish ball juts outside off, Rahul makes room and square cuts it over the point fielder for another boundary.
Deliberate this time from Rahul. He opens the face of the bat to guide it between gully and slip cordon for two.
FOUR! Streaky but runs. A touch fuller this time outside off, KL hangs his bat and gets a thick outside edge. The ball goes through gully and a boundary results.
Nice. It looks so effortless coming out of Broad's hand. A length ball again outside off, KL plays the line but the ball goes past the outside edge for nothing.
On a length around off, defended.

He angles this length ball into Rahul who tries to defend with a straight bat. The bat nips a bit on pitching and takes the inner edge and goes to the square leg region. The batsmen cross over for a single.
Just ahead of a length on the middle and leg line. Blocked by Rahul off the front foot.
Anderson gets his line right this time. He bowls it fuller on the off stump. Rahul gets right behind the line of the ball and defends it.
Fuller and attacking the stumps. Rahul turns it to mid-wicket.
Lets this length ball outside off go past to the keeper.
FOUR! Wayward from Anderson. Goes for the magic delivery from leg to off, but the ball holds its line this time. Rahul flicks this incoming delivery to the deep square leg boundary.
Leading edge. Broad keeps it fuller on off. Dhawan tries to turn it onto the leg side. The ball shapes away after pitching. Takes the leading edge but rolls to the fielder at covers.
Similar short by Rahul but this time there is not much timing. Just a single to mid-wicket.
Rahul uses the inward angle to his advantage. He works this straight ball on a length towards deep square leg. They cross for two.
On a length on off again, Rahul pushes it to the mid-wicket region.
Broad is getting some inward movement. Lands it on a length outside off. Rahul comes forward to defend but the ball takes the inside edge of his bat and onto his pads.
Full and straight on the stumps. Tucked away to mid wicket.
Stuart Broad to bowl from the other end.

FOUR! Streaky but lucky for Dhawan. This length ball from Anderson pitches on middle and off and moves away slightly. takes the outside edge of Dhawan's bat and races through the vacant third man region for the second boundary of the over.
Fuller outside off. Left alone by Dhawan.
Lands this length ball on leg and swing further down the leg side. Dhawan tries to hit it but the swings takes it away from his bat. Bairstow collects.
This length ball on middle comes in. Dhawan tries to work it on the leg side but gets beaten. The ball hits his pads.

FOUR! Classic Cover Drive from Dhawan to get off the mark. Anderson, looking for some swing, pitches it full. But it's fuller than he wanted. Dhawan leans forward and unleashes a beautifully timed and placed cover drive. The ball races across the ropes. Good start for Dhawan and India.
Starts with a length ball on Dhawan's pads. Not much swing on offer there. Dhawan turns it around to mid-wicket.
